messages:
Priya (AE): Quick heads up 11 NordBank IT (Ali) reached out: they want an accelerated POC to move from VendorX to Redwood. Main blockers: adapter work, token billing delta, security signoff, and confirming function-calling parity. Can SE + Eng triage?

Ali (Client-IT): Confirming. We have strict egress IP allowlist, EU data residency, and prefer SCIM/Okta SSO. Also need a short runbook for rollback during canary.

Luca (Sales Eng): Got it. Proposed scope for 10-working-day POC: 1) lightweight shim proxy to accept VendorX requests, 2) run 500 sample prompts through both systems, 3) cost delta report, 4) security questionnaire completion, 5) 48h canary in eu-west.

Sam (Platform Eng): Adapter notes: VendorX sends events as:
```
POST /v1/complete
Headers: X-Session, X-Client
Body: {"conversation":[{"role":"user","text":"..."}], "meta": {...}}
```
Redwood expects: {"model":"rwd-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}], "session": "..."} We can implement a 150-line proxy that maps conversation->messages, normalizes roles, and translates function-calling signature. Will also add token pre-count to estimate cost.

Luca (Sales Eng): Example quick-transform we can give the client for their ops team:
```
// pseudo
let messages = body.conversation.map(m => ({role: m.role, content: m.text}));
let req = {model: 'rwd-1', messages, session: headers['X-Session']};
```
This reduces the integration delta to header mapping + one deploy.

Tess (Security): Security asks: provide SOC2 report, encryption docs, KMS support details, pen-test summary, and our standard questionnaire. Also confirm log retention and whether PII can be redacted before logs reach Redwood analytics.

Priya (AE): Tess, can you paste the questionnaire link? I'll attach to the kickoff pack.

Tess (Security): Sharing: https://redwood.internal/security/questionnaire-v2 (client fill)

Ali (Client-IT): We will redact PII on our side but may need audit logs for specific errors. Also want SLA around log access and retention TTL.

Sam (Platform Eng): On parity testing: we recommend three buckets: 1) exact string parity for templated responses, 2) semantic similarity for open responses (use sentence-transformers cosine >= 0.85), 3) function-calling contract verification (schema match + invocation frequency). We'll run an A/B harness and produce a delta report.

Luca (Sales Eng): Commercials: If customer takes Dedicated for 6+ months we can offer reserved pricing. Migration credit: propose covering up to 40 engineering hours as a one-time credit (we typically cap at $8k). Thoughts?

Priya (AE): That sounds reasonable to Legal. Also ask: if parity failure > 5% on critical prompts, are we open to a remediation sprint in scope?

Sam (Platform Eng): Yes, remediation sprint can be scoped as part of the POC follow-up. We need their failure criteria defined (e.g., BLEU < 0.6 or semantic <0.85).

deploy-bot: Staging environment created: staging-nordbank-3 (region: eu-west-1)

Tess (Security): One more security nuance: VendorX used session cookies for in-flight state. If NordBank wants session affinity, we'll need to surface KV session API or use a state store behind the shim. Call this out in the runbook.

Ali (Client-IT): Noted. We'll provide a 72-hour traffic capture and a set of 200 golden prompts. Also sending legal the questionnaire this afternoon.

Sam (Platform Eng): For billing delta: rough math we use for previews: count tokens after tokenization (we can run on their 72h dump) and multiply by our pay-per-token (hosted) vs their current unit price. Share approx numbers and we'll produce an estimated monthly cost delta within 48 hours of receiving logs.

Luca (Sales Eng): POC timeline (concise):
- Day 0: Kickoff + get dumps + questionnaire
- Day 1-2: Adapter shim + auth mapping
- Day 3: Smoke + token accounting
- Day 5: Run parity harness on 200 prompts
- Day 7: Security review complete
- Day 9-10: Canary (48h) + go/no-go

Priya (AE): Can Eng confirm 0.5 FTE for the first week and 0.25 for canary monitoring?

Sam (Platform Eng): Confirmed 0.5 FTE week1, on-call for canary.

Luca (Sales Eng): I'll draft the handoff doc and include the migration credit proposal.

Priya (AE): Great. Ali, once you drop the traffic dump and the golden prompts, we'll schedule kickoff for next Monday. Thanks all :rocket:
